note: Read alongside the five original supplied documents; an extraction checklist, not independently verified prediction data. Drafts overlap and are not independent studies. Preliminary progress-report yields stay outside production calculations.

fields.Guidance: Structured evidence matrix from the five uploaded oilseed-cake documents to inform Upcycle Compass.
Values below are transcribed/summarised from the supplied documents; they are not automatically independently verified.

Source-reported = explicitly reported in supplied document; Proposed = candidate/hypothesis; Needs verification = unclear source, inconsistent basis, questionable generalisation, or missing batch context.
Start with one feedstock + one application. Sunflower cake → extruded high-protein/fibre snack is a candidate route in the research plan, not yet a validated commercial winner.
Unknown provenance/process/contaminant status must remain unknown or test-first; do not silently convert missing data into PASS.
Do not compare composition values unless material type, extraction route, moisture basis, analytical method and source are known.

Kjeldahl crude protein in the progress report uses nitrogen × 6.25. Store the conversion factor and analytical basis explicitly; 6.25 may not be appropriate for every ingredient without justification.
Reported treatment reductions are study-specific. They are not guaranteed predictions for another batch or processing setup.

No complete, validated process-cost dataset was found in the visible extracted material. Cost per kg protein requires yield, protein retention, utilities, labour, processing, QA, packaging, waste handling and capital boundaries.
LoR and Proximate for DoC May 20 2026; final oilseed cake review paper; Review paper oilseed cake- draft 1_28-08-26; review paper oilseed cake- draft 1; oilseed cake - research plan Aug 5 2026.

fields.Required behaviour: Species, product form, extraction/de-oiling route, dehulling, supplier/lot, origin, intended use
fields.Failure to prevent: Do not infer cold-pressed or solvent-free when route is unknown.

fields.Required behaviour: Protein, moisture, fat, fibre (crude/TDF separate), ash; method, basis, date, lab
fields.Failure to prevent: Assumed defaults must be visibly labelled and excluded from measured batch status.

fields.Required behaviour: Separate safety readiness, technical feasibility, economic feasibility and data confidence
fields.Failure to prevent: Do not compress unknown safety evidence into a single probability or GO score.

fields.Required behaviour: Only show material-relevant hazards/ANFs supported by source or measurement
fields.Failure to prevent: A review-level hazard association is a screening prompt, not proof that a particular lot contains a hazardous level.

fields.Required behaviour: Represent each chain with target compound, reported effect range, conditions, expected trade-offs, evidence scope
fields.Failure to prevent: No universal treatment effect; unknown parameters stay unknown.

fields.Required behaviour: Measured mass balance or explicitly sourced model range
fields.Failure to prevent: Protein concentration and protein retention are different metrics.

fields.Required behaviour: Cost/kg recovered protein on explicit system boundary; include all relevant process costs and losses
fields.Failure to prevent: Do not compare raw-cake cost with imported isolate without matching basis and processing costs.

fields.Required behaviour: Recommend tests based on unresolved safety gate or decision-changing uncertainty
fields.Failure to prevent: Do not show EVPI/EVPPI as ₹0 merely because missing costs/probabilities make it uncomputable.

fields.Required behaviour: Pilot plan: lot sourcing → gate tests → bench trials → sensory/functionality → pilot run → regulatory and economics review
fields.Failure to prevent: The supplied report supports proximate analysis and protein isolation as research areas; actual pilot data must be collected.

fields.Required behaviour: Measured / Published / Assumed / Synthetic / Not supplied / Not applicable / Not verified
fields.Failure to prevent: Keep an A badge if it communicates assumption, but add a legend and never style assumed values as validated evidence.
